svg.font-family: Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
svg.text: phu jack: selecting contigs by iterative search from seed proteins
Seed markers (protein FASTA, one or more sequences)
used when a trusted marker protein exists but no profile HMM does
The prediction cache is shared with phu screen and phu avger
Iterative search (PyHMMER jackhmmer), one seed at a time
After each round the included hits are aligned into a profile, which is searched again.
The search runs for up to 5 rounds (--iterations) and so reaches more distant relatives
than the seed alone. Each seed is searched independently.
Best hit per contig by bit score
With several seeds, --combine-mode decides which contigs are kept
at least one seed's search hits the contig
every seed's search hits the contig
at least --min-seed-hits seeds hit the contig
The profile of the last round can be saved and used as a query elsewhere
the saved profile screens other assemblies directly,
With one seed the file is final-iteration.hmm; with several, one profile per seed
jackhmmer-iterations.tsv records how many hits each round added, which shows
whether the search converged or kept growing.
Hits gained over the rounds are sequence-similarity evidence, not a validated functional or taxonomic assignment.
Contigs, proteins and hits shown are illustrative
